spec.title: Hashrate
spec.description: 10m average across every Bitaxe on the LAN.

spec.title: Efficiency
spec.description: Fleet watts per TH/s, from the 10m hashrate.

spec.title: Best diff
spec.description: Best share difficulty any Bitaxe has found.

spec.title: Distance to a block
spec.description: Network difficulty divided by the best share. Smaller is closer. Green under 1,000, yellow under 100,000, red beyond that.

spec.title: Power
spec.description: Total watts across every Bitaxe. Not a per-device limit.

spec.title: WiFi
spec.description: Weakest WiFi signal in the fleet.

spec.title: Hashrate
spec.description: 15-minute average, summed across miners that are running.

spec.title: Share of Network
spec.description: Parts per billion of the Monero network hashrate.
